name: St. Clare of Montefalco
bio:
Clare was born around 1268 in Montefalco, Italy. At the age of six she joined a community of Franciscan tertiaries led by her sister Joan, and she later became its abbess, guiding the community with wisdom and charity.

She was known for her deep devotion to the Passion of Christ and for her care of the poor. After her death, symbols of the Passion were said to be found impressed upon her heart.

She died on August 17, 1308, and was canonized in 1881. She is venerated as the patron saint of the poor and of those seeking spiritual insight.

prayer.text: O God, who impressed the instruments of the Passion upon the heart of Clare of Montefalco, grant through her intercession that the poor may find hope in Christ and be comforted in their need. We ask this through Christ our Lord. Amen.
